If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: King of Shambling Bones
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Deathrattle unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target's melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Immortal Conqueror
abilities.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within enemy territory.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly Deathrattle units while they are wholly within 6" of that objective or terrain feature.

abilities.name: Ancient Barrow Curse
abilities.effect: If an attack made with this unit's King's Relic Weapon scores a critical hit, the target unit becomes cursed for the rest of the battle. Subtract 1 from save rolls for cursed units even if this unit has been destroyed. Designer's Note: *Multiple enemy units can become cursed by this ability but the same enemy unit cannot become cursed more than once.*

abilities.name: Royal Companions
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-Hero Deathrattle Cavalry unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Lord of Trampling Bones
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly Deathrattle Cavalry units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Zondara Rivenheart
abilities.effect: While this unit's Zondara Rivenheart is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1).

abilities.name: Wrest from the Realms
abilities.effect: If this unit is in a Soulblight Gravelords army, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit, then roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. You cannot pick the same terrain feature more than once per battle. 1 *Cruel Hope:* No effect. 2-4 *Cursed Flesh:* You can return D3 slain models to this unit. 5-6 *Borrowed Power:* Pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Hero wholly within 12" of this unit that does not have an artefact of power. You can pick an artefact of power from the Soulblight Gravelords faction rules that no other friendly Hero has and give it to that Hero.

battleTraits.name: The Hunger
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly Vampire unit that used a Fight ability this turn to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Heal (D3) each target. Heal (2D3) the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a Fight ability

battleTraits.name: The Unquiet Dead
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Deathrattle or Deadwalkers unit that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the grave. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units in the grave than there are on the battlefield.

battleTraits.name: Endless Legions
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-Unique Deathrattle or Deadwalkers unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Hero or wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units. If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use Charge abilities this turn.

battleTraits.name: Deathly Invocation
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Hero to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly Deathrattle or Deadwalkers units wholly within 12" of that Hero to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For each target: • If the target is damaged, Heal (3) the target. • If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

battleTraits.name: The Rising Dead
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in the grave.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre and more than 9" from all enemy unit, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory, and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Ancient Burial Sites
battleTraits.effect: If there is a friendly Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield, you can set up to 2 additional friendly Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives, and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. Designer's Note: *The original* Cursed Sepulchre *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

abilities.name: Aristocracy of the Night
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly Vampire units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly VAMPIRE units that charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Tide of Bones and Blades
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Deathrattle units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

abilities.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Deadwalkers units in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target: • Make a pile-in move. • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Horror Unending
abilities.effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the 'Deathly Invocation' ability.

abilities.name: Wardens of the Wolf
abilities.effect: Each time 1 or more slain models are returned to a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Infantry or Beast unit wholly within 12" of a friendly Belladamma Volga, Radukar the Wolf, Radukar the Beast, Ivya Volga, Lady Annika, Kritza, Torgillius the Chamberlain, Gorslav the Gravekeeper or Watch Captain Halgrim, add 1 to the number of slain models returned to that unit.

abilities.name: Lash of the Sire
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly Soulblight Gravelords unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+: • If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of the move. • If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

abilities.name: Unbending Will
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Deathrattle or Deadwalkers unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add D6 to the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Unhinged Rampager
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.

abilities.name: Amulet of Graves
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield, set up a Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

abilities.name: Shard of Night
abilities.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

abilities.name: Terminus Clock
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy Wizards while they are within 18" of this unit.

abilities.name: Prison of Grief
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has Strike-last until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Vile Transference
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelord Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, Heal(D3) the caster.

abilities.name: Waste Away
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Summon Hand of Nagash
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Hand of Nagash on the battlefield, pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Hand of Nagash wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Unholy Reliquary on the battlefield, pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Unholy Reliquary endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them, and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Sanguine Swarm
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Sanguine Swarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Sanguine Swarm endless spell wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Sanguine Swarm endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Chill Grasp
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the following effects apply until the start of your next turn: • While the target is within 3" of this Manifestation, the target has a maximum control score of 1 that cannot be modified. • While the target is within 3" of this Manifestation, the target cannot use Move abilities.

abilities.name: Inescapable Reach
abilities.declare: This Manifestation can only use this ability if it has not been set up this turn.
abilities.effect: Remove this Manifestation from the battlefield and set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, this Manifestation can move a number of inches equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Draw on Power
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Hero wholly within 12" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following: • Heal (D3) the target. • Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. Then, this Manifestation is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: Leeching Bites
abilities.effect: Each time an attack made by this Manifestation scores a critical hit, Heal (1) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Leeching Bites.

abilities.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.
